role: Speculative enquiry: graduate site engineer (Atherton Tablelands, Far North QLD)
subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate site engineer, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello RCG recruitment team,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your Working at RCG page invites people to email this address, so I wanted to introduce myself.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project in charge engineer. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and open to discussing relocation.

Your road rehabilitation and highway safety work for Main Roads is close to the road and pavement design I studied, and your careers page quotes an engineer who started with RCG as a site engineer in 2019. My site experience is under a year and none of it is in Australia yet, so the training you offer matters to me.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate site engineer opening, now or later? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

SPECULATIVE_ENQUIRY. SEEK sweeps at 3, 7 and 14 days (60, 60 then 80 details, digest up to 40) plus the Victoria off-SEEK rotation found no new junior adverts that cleared screening (19 never-screened adverts, all agency, 3+ years, TMR experience, student-only or experienced roles; every Victorian off-SEEK find was already on the tracker), so this is the runbook's one speculative enquiry. RCG careers page read 13 Oct 2026 AEDT shows no engineering vacancy and invites applications by email to recruitment@robinsoncivil.com.au. Relocation to Far North Queensland is not promised; Marc to confirm before any interview.
Checked 13 Oct 2026 AEDT. recruitment@robinsoncivil.com.au is published by RCG on its own Career Opportunities page as the way to apply; admin@ on other pages is general and was not used. No named engineering contact email is published. Gmail in:anywhere search for robinsoncivil / Robinson Civil / RCG found no prior contact; tracker check found no RCG record.
